takeaways.title: Technostrategic Language & Nuclear Defense Abstraction
takeaways.detail: Carol Cohn demonstrates that nuclear defense intellectuals sanitize catastrophic destruction through mathematical modeling and clinical euphemisms ('clean bombs', 'collateral damage'), placing planners in an active, detached control position while excluding victim perspectives.

takeaways.title: Earth's Four Spheres & Planetary Energy Budget
takeaways.detail: Planetary stability relies on dynamic equilibrium across the lithosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere, and biosphere. Earth operates as an open system for energy (~1361 W/m² solar constant minus 30% planetary albedo) but an essentially closed material system.

takeaways.title: Hydraulic Empires & Second-Nature Infrastructures
takeaways.detail: Paul Sutter and Donald Worster show that the modern American West is not an empty frontier but a highly orchestrated 'hydraulic society' where federal Bureau of Reclamation mega-dams commodified water to subsidize corporate agriculture and urban growth.

takeaways.title: Conservation (Pinchot) vs Preservation (Muir) Paradigms
takeaways.detail: The Hetch Hetchy dispute codified the enduring tension between utilitarian resource conservation and romantic preservation, while modern geography critiques the erasure of Indigenous stewardship in the traditional 'Wilderness Myth'.

takeaways.title: Spatial Projections & Exercise Progression (FITT-VP)
takeaways.detail: All 2D map projections mathematically distort area, shape, or distance (GCS vs PCS). Concurrently, physical training relies on systematic progressive overload structured via Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type, Volume, and Progression.
